run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to compute the factorial of a given integer n
test_f_gold: test the f_gold factorial function against multiple input parameters and compare results
create_f_filled: create a f_filled function that computes factorial to match the f_gold reference implementation
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold recursive factorial function to use an iterative approach instead
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which recursively computes the factorial of a non-negative integer
